triage_summary.root_cause: Race condition in next_id() function at storage.py:127. The function calculates new IDs based on max(todo.id) from an in-memory snapshot of todos. When two processes/threads call add() concurrently, both read the same todos list, compute the same next_id, and create todos with duplicate IDs.

risk_points.description: add() loads todos, computes next_id, appends, and saves - no locking between these operations
next_id() uses pure in-memory calculation with no persistence or atomicity guarantees
save() uses atomic rename but the entire add() operation (load->compute->save) is not atomic

evidence.existing_tests: tests/test_storage_atomicity.py has test_concurrent_save_from_multiple_processes but it doesn't verify ID uniqueness

verification_targets.description: Add regression test that verifies concurrent add() operations generate unique IDs
Verify fix doesn't break existing functionality

triage_summary.proposed_fix_approach: Use file-based locking (fcntl or portalocker) to make the load->compute_id->save sequence atomic in add(). Alternative approaches: (1) persistent counter in JSON file, (2) UUID-based IDs instead of sequential integers, (3) detect and reject duplicate IDs at load time.

plan.summary: Use file-based locking (filelock library) to serialize add operations, ensuring atomic read-modify-write for ID generation. The lock will be acquired at the start of add() and released after save() completes.

test_first.description: Add a regression test that spawns multiple concurrent processes calling app.add() and verifies all resulting todos have unique IDs.
test_first.test_content: def test_concurrent_add_generates_unique_ids(): spawns 10 processes, each calls app.add('task'), final storage should have 10 todos with unique IDs 1-10

implementation_sequence: 1. Add add_todo() method in storage.py using filelock to wrap load->next_id->save sequence atomically
3. Modify TodoApp.add() in cli.py to use the new atomic storage.add_todo() method
verification_commands: uv run ruff check src/flywheel/storage.py src/flywheel/cli.py tests/test_storage_atomicity.py

implementation.summary: Added atomic add_todo() method to TodoStorage using filelock library for cross-platform file locking
risks: File locking adds small overhead for add operations
Lock files (.lock) are created alongside the database file
Stale lock files may remain if process crashes during operation
limitations: Only addresses the add operation; other concurrent operations (mark_done, remove) still have potential race conditions but don't affect ID uniqueness
